title: Nan Can Not See the Cap
lines: Nan can not see the tan cap.
She can see lots of bags, but not the cap.
A dog sits at the bin.
"A cap is not a bed," said Nan.
Nan taps the dog. The dog hops up.
Nan pops the cap on and lets the dog up at the bin.
scoring_note: This passage says "can not", "is not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "can't" or "isn't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
